author: JCPie
body:
So, I thought HetBeerKanaalPvP was a bit suspicious, so I decided to spectate him.
To you to decide; Killaura or not? This was the most suspicious footage I found, if you need more, I can send you everything. In this clip you can see him toggle on his teammate.
Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RTRZzdw3LA0&feature=youtu.be

Regards,

JCPie
